summary: Promote the browser-submit gate out of per-ticket throwaways into `make browser`
description:
Shipped as `a9b81de` (2026-08-06) and **never created on the board** — the key was used in a
commit without a ticket file ever existing. Reconstructed 2026-08-08 during a board validation.

Makes the one quality gate this repo cannot automate into a command anyone can run:
`make browser`, backed by `scripts/browser.sh`, with specs committed under `test/browser/`
rather than written from scratch per ticket and thrown away.

**This is the substance of TKT-196**, which was still sitting in Backlog when this landed under a
different key. See the disposition comment on TKT-196.

**Why it could not be part of `make check`:** it needs the host's real Chrome, so CI cannot run it.
That is a property of the gate, not a gap in it — `AGENTS.md` now says so explicitly.
